newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines August load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines August load factor up.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Tuesday its August passenger load factor rose 4.64 points to 62.24 percent from 57.60 percent.
It said revenue passenger miles rose 122 percent to 64.9 million from 29.2 million, and available seat miles gained 105.4 percent to 104.3 million from 50.8 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor rose 12.38 points to 65.26 percent from 52.88 percent in 1995. Revenue passenger miles jumped 153.6 percent to 476 million from 185.7 million, and available seat miles rose 105.5 percent to 729.3 million from 346.9 million.
